--sd-font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", monospace; --sd-transition: 150ms ease; /* Standard animation */ ``` --- ### 3. COMPONENTS & UI ELEMENTS #### 3.1 Header Bar (`.sd-header`) - **Location:** Top of sidebar - **Content:** Title + connection status - **Typography:** Mono labels (10px, uppercase), brand-colored title (14px, 700) - **Status states:** `--connecting` (orange/conditioning), `--disconnected` (red/vae) #### 3.2 Stage Bar (`.sd-stage-bar`) - **Appears during:** Agent thinking/tool execution - **Content:** Stage label (UNDERSTAND/DISCOVER/PILOT/VERIFY/BRAIN) + detail text - **Animation:** Pulsing opacity (1.5s) using `@keyframes sd-pulse` - **Visibility:** Hidden by default, shown during processing #### 3.3 Message Bubbles (`.sd-message`) - **User messages:** Aligned right, `#1a1d2a` background - **Agent messages:** Aligned left, `#141620` background - **System messages:** Centered, transparent, italic, muted color - **Label:** Mono, 10px, uppercase, color-coded (muted for user, brand for agent) - **Body:** Rich text rendering (see Section 3.4) #### 3.4 Text Rendering Classes - **`.sd-text-body`** — Standard body text (12px, sans, secondary color) - Paragraphs with 8px margin-bottom (removed on last child) - **`.sd-code-inline`** — `code` text (11px mono, elevated bg, accent color, 1px 5px padding) - **`.sd-code-block`** — ````code blocks```` (11px mono, input bg, monospace, pre formatting, border) - **`.sd-text-bold`** — `**bold**` text (600 weight, primary color) #### 3.5 Typing Indicator (`.sd-typing`) - **Animation:** Three dots with staggered 0.15s/0.3s delays - **Keyframes:** Scale + opacity pulse (0.8→1.0, 0.3→1.0 opacity) - **Duration:** 1.2s infinite #### 3.6 Input Bar (`.sd-input-bar`) - **Layout:** Flex row with `gap: 6px` - **Input field:** 12px sans, border transitions to brand green on focus - **Send button:** Brand green background, dark text, 600 weight - Hover: 0.9 opacity - Active: 0.8 opacity - Disabled: elevated bg, muted text - **Placeholder:** "Ask me anything about your workflow..." #### 3.7 Panel Components All panels built dynamically via JavaScript factory functions in `chat.js`: **Panel structure:** ``` ┌─────────────────────┐ │ HEADER │ Label + Badge, Title, Summary, Stats ├─────────────────────┤ │ SECTIONS (collapsed)│ Collapsible with colored dots │ ├─ Signal Flow │ Flow chains showing data paths │ ├─ Models & Loaders │ Slot tags (colored chips) │ └─ ... │ ├─────────────────────┤ │ FOOTER │ Status + Action buttons └─────────────────────┘ ``` **Component Factories (in `chat.js`):** 1. **`createSlotTag(label, slotType)`** - Colored chip: dot (glow shadow at 55%) + label - Background: `${color}1f` (12% opacity) - Border: `${color}40` (25% opacity) - Text color: slot color 2. **`createCollapsibleSection(title, dotColor, count, defaultOpen, buildBody)`** - Trigger button with colored dot + title + count + chevron - Lazy body loading (only built on first expand) - Chevron rotates 90° on open (CSS transition) - `defaultOpen=false` except for Signal Flow and Capabilities 3. **`createFlowChain(nodes, pathLabel)`** - Nodes: `{label, slotType}` array - Display: `Node1 → Node2 → Node3...` - Node styling: slot color text + background at 10% opacity - Arrow styling: muted color 4. **`createDetailRow(label, value)`** - Two-column layout with dotted leader - Label: sans, 11px, muted - Value: mono, 10.5px, secondary, right-aligned 5. **`createCapabilityRow(label, desc, color)`** - Dot (4px, colored) + label + separator line + description - Label: sans, 11px, accent, 500 weight - Description: sans, 10.5px, muted 6. **`createActionFooter(status, actions)`** - Status: mono, 10px, muted - Buttons: secondary (transparent + border) or primary (brand green) - Button padding: 5px 14px, border-radius: 4px 7. **`createPanel(panelData)`** - Master factory: builds header + sections + footer - Schema: ```javascript { type: "workflow_analysis"|"discovery"|"execution"|"error", header: { label, badge, title, summary, stats: [{value, label}, ...] }, sections: [{ title, dotColor, count, defaultOpen, type: "flow_chain"|"slot_tags"|"detail_rows"|"capability_rows", data: {...} }], footer: {status, actions: [{label, variant}]} } ``` #### 3.8 Scrollbar Styling - **Width:** 3px - **Track:** Transparent - **Thumb:** `--sd-border` color - **Hover:** `--sd-text-muted` color --- ### 4. CHAT RENDERING (`chat.js`) **`renderText(rawText)` function:** - **Input:** Raw agent response text - **Parsing:** Splits on triple-backtick blocks - **Output:** DocumentFragment with styled elements (NO innerHTML) - **Supported markdown:** - ````code blocks```` → `
`
  - `` `inline code` `` → ``
  - `**bold**` → ``
  - Paragraphs on double newlines
  - Single newlines converted to `
` within paragraphs

**Security note:** All content via `.textContent`, never `.innerHTML`

---

### 5. WEBSOCKET INTEGRATION (`sidebar.js`)

**Connection:**
- **URL:** `ws://localhost:8188/superduper/ws` (or `wss://` over HTTPS)
- **Class:** `AgentConnection` with exponential backoff reconnection
  - Initial delay: 1000ms
  - Max delay: 15000ms
  - Backoff multiplier: 1.5x

**Message Types Received:**

| Type | Payload | Handling |
|------|---------|----------|
| `connected` | `{conversation_id}` | Status update |
| `text_delta` | `{text: string}` | Stream text chunk, show typing indicator |
| `message` | `{content: string}` | Final rendered message |
| `panel` | `{panel: object}` | Structured panel data |
| `stage` | `{stage, detail}` | Update stage bar (UNDERSTAND/DISCOVER/PILOT/VERIFY/BRAIN/DONE) |
| `error` | `{message, recoverable}` | Show error + potentially recover |

**Workflow Injection:**
- Captures current ComfyUI canvas workflow via `app.graphToPrompt()`
- Sends in chat payload: `{type: "chat", content: string, workflow?: object}`
- Backend uses for context injection into system prompt

---

### 6. BACKEND INTEGRATION (`routes.py`)

**HTTP/WebSocket Routes:**

```python
POST /superduper/chat      # Simple request/response (REST)
GET  /superduper/status    # Agent + connection state
GET  /superduper/ws        # WebSocket (primary interface)
```

**Panel Building Functions** (convert tool results to UI panels):

1. **`_panel_workflow_analysis(result)`**
   - Analyzes load_workflow / validate_workflow results
   - Extracts: node count, connections, signal flow (via BFS)
   - Groups nodes by slot type (MODEL, CLIP, VAE, etc.)
   - Outputs: panel with Signal Flow (open) + collapsible slot sections

2. **`_panel_discovery(result, tool_input)`**
   - Converts discover tool results to discovery panels
   - Shows: top 5 results with name, description, source, stats
   - Tags: installed status + model type

3. **`_classify_slot(class_type)`**
   - Maps node class_type to slot type via keywords
   - Used to assign colors to nodes

**Stage Mapping** (tool name → intelligence layer):
- UNDERSTAND: workflow parsing, node inspection, model listing
- DISCOVER: search, discovery, templates
- PILOT: workflow patching, node editing, session management
- VERIFY: execution, validation, output analysis
- BRAIN: vision, planning, memory, optimization, demo

---

### 7. COMFYUI EXTENSION REGISTRATION

**File:** `ui/__init__.py`

```python
NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS = {}
NODE_CLASS_DISPLAY_MAPPINGS = {}
WEB_DIRECTORY = "./web"
```

**Registration:**
- Exports `WEB_DIRECTORY` → ComfyUI serves `/web/css` and `/web/js` as extension assets
- Mounts aiohttp routes on ComfyUI's PromptServer at startup
- Sidebar registers via `app.extensionManager.registerSidebarTab()`

**Sidebar Configuration:**
```javascript
{
  id: "superduper",
  icon: "pi pi-bolt",              // Primeicons icon
  title: "SUPER DUPER",
  tooltip: "SUPER DUPER AI Co-pilot",
  type: "custom",
  render(el) { buildSidebar(el); }
}
```

---

### 8. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY (from Design System Document)

**Three Core Principles:**

1. **Summary-First** — First visible element answers "what is this" in one line
2. **Progressive Disclosure** — Show minimum, let user drill; collapse by default
3. **Native Vocabulary** — Use ComfyUI's colors, terms, spatial patterns (no emoji, no markdown headers)

**The 3-Second Test:** Artist must understand what happened, what matters, and what to do next within 3 seconds of looking at a panel.

**Semantic Color Mapping:**
- Use slot colors when displaying node types or concepts
- E.g., "loaded a model" → MODEL color (#B39DDB)
- Flow chains show signal path through nodes with colored nodes

---

### 9. TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

**Type Scale:**

| Element | Size | Font | Weight | Tracking |
|---------|------|------|--------|----------|
| Panel title | 16px | sans | 600 | -0.02em |
| Section header | 12px | sans | 500 | 0.01em |
| Body text | 12px | sans | 400 | normal |
| Label (uppercase) | 10px | mono | 400 | 0.06-0.08em |
| Tag / code | 11px | mono | 400 | 0.01em |
| Detail value | 10.5px | mono | 400 | 0.01em |
| Stat number | 14px | mono | 600 | normal |

**Rules:**
- Mono for: node names, values, counts, code, tags, status labels
- Sans for: descriptions, titles, body text, buttons
- Never mix mono and sans on the same line (except label + value pairs)

---

### 10. SPACING & LAYOUT

**Grid Unit:** 4px base

| Element | Value | Purpose |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Micro gap | 4px | Between dot and label |
| Small gap | 6px | Between tags in row |
| Medium gap | 8-10px | Between items in list |
| Section padding | 14-16px | Horizontal |
| Section gap | 12px | Between content blocks |
| Header padding | 16px top, 14px bottom | |
| Footer padding | 10px vertical | |

**Vertical Rhythm:**
- 1px separator line between sections (`--sd-border-subtle`)
- 12px gap between content blocks within sections
- No double-lines or heavy borders — separation via color shifts + spacing

---

### 11. ANTI-PATTERNS (Never Do This)

| Anti-Pattern | Why It Fails | Solution |
|--------------|-------------|----------|
| Emoji as headers 🎯 | Not native to ComfyUI | Colored dots using slot colors |
| Markdown bullet walls | Equal visual weight | Collapsible sections + tags |
| "What This Excels At" | Sales copy | "Capabilities" spec sheet (concrete) |
| Bold **every** node name | Visual noise | Colored mono-font tags |
| "Would you like me to..." | Passive, wastes space | Action buttons in footer |
| Restating the question | Artist knows their ask | Jump to answer |
| H2/H3 markdown headers | Flat hierarchy | Progressive disclosure (collapse) |
| "This is sophisticated" | Subjective filler | Concrete details: "Dual-path with tiling" |
| Long paragraphs | Nobody reads para 3 | Summary + collapsible detail |
| Numbered lists for features | Implies sequence | Capability rows or inline |

---

### 12. CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION STATUS

**Phase 1-3 Complete:**
- ✅ 50+ intelligence tools + 27 brain tools
- ✅ Chat rendering with streaming + typing indicator
- ✅ Panel component factory system
- ✅ Workflow analysis panels (Signal Flow + node groups)
- ✅ Discovery panels (search results)
- ✅ WebSocket bidirectional communication
- ✅ Design system documented (510 lines)

**Stubs Ready for Implementation:**
- `discover.js` — Panel specific to discovery results (ready for expansion)
- `status.js` — Execution status panel (ready for expansion)

**No HTML Files:** 
- Entire UI rendered via vanilla JavaScript `createElement()` + `textContent` (security-first)
- No templating, no JSX, no build step required

---

### 13. KEY CODE SNIPPETS

**Loading the Design System:**
```javascript
// In sidebar.js
const cssLink = document.createElement("link");
cssLink.rel = "stylesheet";
cssLink.href = new URL("../css/superduper.css", import.meta.url).href;

return {
  type: "workflow_analysis",
  header: {
    label: "workflow · analysis",
    badge: wf_type,  // "video gen", "img2img", etc.
    title: "Workflow Analysis",
    summary: f"{len(nodes)} nodes, {conn_count} connections.",
    stats: [
      {"value": str(len(nodes)), "label": "nodes"},
      {"value": str(conn_count), "label": "connections"},
      {"value": wf_type, "label": "type"},
    ],
  },
  sections: [
    {
      title: "Signal Flow",
      dotColor: "#00BB81",
      type: "flow_chain",
      defaultOpen: True,
      data: {"chains": [{"nodes": flow}]}
    },
    ...more sections...
  ],
  footer: {status: "loaded", actions: [{label: "Modify", variant: "secondary"}]}
}
```

---

## SUMMARY TABLE

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Frontend Framework** | Vanilla JS (no React/Vue/build tools) |
| **Styling** | CSS custom properties + inline styles |
| **Color Scheme** | ComfyUI dark theme + brand jade green (#00BB81) |
| **Typography** | Inter (sans) + JetBrains Mono (mono) |
| **Chat Transport** | WebSocket at `/superduper/ws` |

| **Design Files** | `docs/COMFYUI_AGENT_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` (comprehensive spec) |

# Agent Team Dispatch

Generate self-contained Claude Code prompts that orchestrate parallel agent teams with MOE specialization, file-conflict prevention, hard phase gates, and real-time ASCII status reporting.

## When to Use

- User has a implementation plan / blueprint and wants it executed by Claude Code
- User wants to parallelize work across specialist agents
- User wants live progress tracking during Claude Code execution
- Any multi-file code change that benefits from role specialization

## Workflow

1. **Read the reference template** at `references/DISPATCH_TEMPLATE.md`
2. **Gather context** from the user about what needs to be built
3. **Fill the template** with project-specific agents, tasks, files, and gates
4. **Output a single .md file** the user pastes into Claude Code

## Key Principles

### File Ownership Prevents Conflicts
Every source file is owned by exactly ONE agent. Other agents can read it but never write. If an agent needs changes in another agent's file, it generates a patch — the orchestrator applies it after the owning agent completes.

### Phases Are Hard Gates
No agent in Phase N+1 starts until ALL Phase N tasks pass their gate checks. Gates are concrete bash commands that return pass/fail. No subjective gates.

### MOE Roles Are Specific
Each agent has a named expertise that determines HOW it approaches problems, not just WHAT files it touches. The MOE role affects code style, error handling patterns, and what the agent prioritizes.

### Status Bars Are Mandatory
After every completed task, the executing agent prints the full sprint status bar. This is the user's only visibility into progress. Never skip it.

## Reference Files

- `references/DISPATCH_TEMPLATE.md` — The parameterized template. Read this first, always.
- `references/STATUS_FORMAT.md` — Status bar format specification and examples.
- `references/EXAMPLES.md` — Example dispatches for common sprint types.

# Status Bar Format Specification

## Purpose
The status bar is the user's ONLY visibility into agent progress during Claude Code execution. It must be printed after every task completion — no exceptions.

## Symbol Legend

| Symbol | Meaning | When to Use |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| ✓ | Done | Task completed successfully |
| ▶ | Active | Task currently being worked on |
| ○ | Pending | Task not yet started |
| ✗ | Failed | Task failed (include error before status bar) |
| █ | Progress fill | Filled portion of progress bar |
| ░ | Progress empty | Unfilled portion of progress bar |

## Progress Bar Calculation

```
total_tasks = sum of all tasks across all agents
done_tasks = count of ✓ tasks
active_tasks = count of ▶ tasks
pct = round((done_tasks / total_tasks) * 100)

bar_width = 20 characters
filled = round(pct / 100 * bar_width)
empty = bar_width - filled
bar = "█" * filled + "░" * empty
```

Per-phase calculation is the same but scoped to tasks within that phase.

## Format

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  {PROJECT} — {SPRINT} STATUS                                ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                              ║
║  Phase {N}: {NAME}          [{bar}] {pct}%                  ║
║    {AGENT}  {icon} {T1} {sym}  {T2} {sym}  ...              ║
║                                                              ║
║  Overall: [{bar}] {pct}%  ({done}/{total} tasks)            ║
║                                                              ║
║  Legend: ✓ done  ▶ active  ○ pending  ✗ failed              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

## Rules

1. **Print after EVERY task** — not just phases or milestones
2. **Show ALL phases** — including future ones (they show all ○)
3. **On failure** — print error details ABOVE the status bar, then the bar with ✗
4. **On gate check** — print the bar showing gate result
5. **Final bar** — on sprint completion, show the complete bar with summary stats

## Scaling

For sprints with many tasks (30+), abbreviate:

```
║    AGENT  ◆ [8/10 ✓, 1 ▶, 1 ○]                             ║
```

For sprints with few tasks (<10), show every task ID individually.

## Agent Icons

Assign each agent a unique Unicode symbol for visual scanning:

```
◆ ⟡ ◈ ⬡ ◇ ○ ◉ ▣ △ ☆
```

Pick icons that are visually distinct from each other. Consistency matters — once assigned, an agent keeps its icon for the entire sprint.

   282→| Adding docs/RAG | Knowledge | Research then integrate |
   283→| Fixing bugs | Bug Fix | Diagnose before cutting |
   284→| Swapping dependencies | Migration | Map before you move |
   285→| Custom | Start from DISPATCH_TEMPLATE.md | Build your own |

   292→| Medium | 3-5 | 2-3 | 10-20 | 30-60 min |
   293→| Large | 5-7 | 3-4 | 20-35 | 1-2 hours |
   294→| XL | 6+ | 4+ | 35+ | 2+ hours (consider splitting) |
   295→
   296→If you're over 35 tasks, consider splitting into two sequential sprints.

## Pattern 4: Bug Fix Sprint (3 agents, 2 phases)

Use for: Fixing multiple related bugs in a focused sprint.
Agents: Diagnostician, Surgeon, Validator.

Phase 1: DIAGNOSE — Diagnostician reads code, writes root cause analysis
Phase 2: FIX + VALIDATE — Surgeon fixes (parallel with) Validator writing tests

---

## Pattern 5: Migration Sprint (4 agents, 3 phases)

Use for: Migrating from one system/API/framework to another.
Agents: Mapper, Builder, Migrator, Validator.

Phase 1: MAP — Mapper analyzes old + new APIs, builds translation table
Phase 2: BUILD — Builder creates new implementation, Migrator updates callsites
Phase 3: VALIDATE — Validator runs comparative tests old vs new

## Choosing Your Pattern

| Situation | Pattern | Why |
|-----------|---------|-----|
| Adding a feature | Feature Build | Clean backend/frontend/test split |
| Restructuring code | Refactor | Analyze-first prevents breakage |
| Adding docs/RAG | Knowledge | Research then integrate |
| Fixing bugs | Bug Fix | Diagnose before cutting |
| Swapping dependencies | Migration | Map before you move |
| Custom | Start from DISPATCH_TEMPLATE.md | Build your own |

## Sizing Guide

| Sprint Size | Agents | Phases | Tasks | Estimated Time |
|-------------|--------|--------|-------|----------------|
| Small | 2-3 | 2 | 5-10 | 15-30 min |
| Medium | 3-5 | 2-3 | 10-20 | 30-60 min |
| Large | 5-7 | 3-4 | 20-35 | 1-2 hours |
| XL | 6+ | 4+ | 35+ | 2+ hours (consider splitting) |

If you're over 35 tasks, consider splitting into two sequential sprints.

   401→    results_list = result.get("results", [])
   402→    if not results_list:
   403→        return None
   404→
   405→    query = tool_input.get("query", "search")
   406→    category = tool_input.get("category", "all")
   407→
   408→    sections = []
   409→    max_results = 5
   410→    for item in results_list[:max_results]:
   411→        name = item.get("name", item.get("title", "Unknown"))
   412→        desc = item.get("description", "")[:120]
   413→        source = item.get("source", "")
   414→        installed = item.get("installed", False)
   415→
   416→        tags = []
   417→        if item.get("model_type") or item.get("type"):
   418→            t = item.get("model_type") or item.get("type")
   419→            slot = _classify_slot(str(t))
   420→            tags.append({"label": str(t), "slotType": slot})
   421→        if installed:
   422→            tags.append({"label": "installed", "slotType": "controlnet"})
   423→
   424→        rows = []
   425→        if source:
   426→            rows.append({"label": "Source", "value": source})
   427→        if item.get("downloads"):
   428→            rows.append({"label": "Downloads", "value": str(item["downloads"])})
   429→        if item.get("rating"):
   430→            rows.append({"label": "Rating", "value": str(item["rating"])})
   431→
   432→        section_data = {}
   433→        section_type = "detail_rows"
   434→        if tags:
   435→            section_type = "slot_tags"
   436→            section_data["tags"] = tags
   437→        if rows:
   438→            section_type = "detail_rows"
   439→            section_data["rows"] = rows
   440→
   441→        sections.append({
   442→            "title": name,
   443→            "dotColor": "#00BB81",
   444→            "count": None,
   445→            "defaultOpen": len(sections) == 0,  # first result open
   446→            "type": section_type,
   447→            "data": section_data,
   448→        })
   449→
   450→    return {
   451→        "type": "discovery",
   452→        "header": {
   453→            "label": f"discovery \u00b7 {category}",
   454→            "badge": str(len(results_list)),
   455→            "title": f'Results for "{query}"',
   456→            "summary": f"Found {len(results_list)} result{'s' if len(results_list) != 1 else ''}. "
   457→                       f"Top result: {results_list[0].get('name', '?')}.",
   458→            "stats": [
   459→                {"value": str(len(results_list)), "label": "found"},
   460→            ],
   461→        },
   462→        "sections": sections,
   463→        "footer": {
   464→            "status": "ready",
   465→            "actions": [{"label": "Details", "variant": "secondary"}],
   466→        },
   467→    }
   468→
   469→
   470→# Tools that produce panelable results
   471→_PANEL_TOOLS = {
   472→    "load_workflow", "validate_workflow",
   473→    "discover",
   474→}
   475→
   476→
   477→def _build_panel_for_tool(name: str, tool_input: dict, result_json: str) -> dict | None:
   478→    """Dispatch tool result to appropriate panel builder. Returns panel dict or None."""
   479→    if name not in _PANEL_TOOLS:
   480→        return None
   481→
   482→    try:
   483→        result = json.loads(result_json) if isinstance(result_json, str) else result_json
   484→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
   485→        return None
   486→
   487→    if isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("error"):
   488→        return None
   489→
   490→    if name in ("load_workflow", "validate_workflow"):
   491→        return _panel_workflow_analysis(result)
   492→    elif name == "discover":
   493→        return _panel_discovery(result, tool_input)
   494→
   495→    return None
   496→
   497→
   498→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   499→# Synchronous agent runner (called from thread)
   500→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   501→
   502→def _run_agent_sync(conv: ConversationState, user_text: str, msg_queue: queue.Queue):
   503→    """Run the agent loop synchronously, pushing events to msg_queue.
   504→
   505→    Events are dicts: {"type": "text_delta"|"tool_call"|"stage"|"done"|"error", ...}
   506→    """
   507→    from agent.main import run_agent_turn
   508→    from agent.tools import ALL_TOOLS
   509→
   510→    conv._build_system()
   511→    conv.messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user_text})
   512→
   513→    max_turns = 15  # safety limit per user message
   514→
   515→    for turn in range(max_turns):
   516→        try:
   517→            def on_text(text):
   518→                msg_queue.put({"type": "text_delta", "text": text})
   519→
   520→            def on_tool(name, inp):
   521→                # Infer stage from tool name
   522→                stage = _infer_stage(name)
   523→                msg_queue.put({
   524→                    "type": "tool_call",
   525→                    "tool": name,
   526→                    "stage": stage,
   527→                })
   528→
   529→            def on_result(name, inp, result_json):
   530→                panel = _build_panel_for_tool(name, inp, result_json)
   531→                if panel:
   532→                    msg_queue.put({"type": "panel", "panel": panel})
   533→
   534→            conv.messages, done = run_agent_turn(
   535→                _client,
   536→                conv.messages,
   537→                conv.system_prompt,
   538→                on_text_delta=on_text,
   539→                on_tool_call=on_tool,
   540→                on_tool_result=on_result,
   541→            )
   542→
   543→            if done:
   544→                msg_queue.put({"type": "done"})
   545→                return
   546→
   547→        except Exception as e:
   548→            log.error("Agent turn error: %s", e, exc_info=True)
   549→            msg_queue.put({"type": "error", "message": str(e)})
   550→            return
   551→
   552→    msg_queue.put({"type": "done"})
   553→
   554→
   555→def _infer_stage(tool_name: str) -> str:
   556→    """Map tool name to intelligence layer stage."""
   557→    understand = {
   558→        "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
   559→        "is_comfyui_running", "get_all_nodes", "get_node_info",
   560→        "get_system_stats", "get_queue_status", "get_history",
   561→        "list_custom_nodes", "list_models", "get_models_summary",
   562→        "read_node_source",
   563→    }
   564→    discover = {
   565→        "discover", "find_missing_nodes", "check_registry_freshness",
   566→        "get_install_instructions", "get_civitai_model", "get_trending_models",
   567→        "list_workflow_templates", "get_workflow_template",
   568→        "check_node_updates", "get_repo_releases",
   569→        "identify_model_family", "check_model_compatibility",
   570→    }
   571→    pilot = {
   572→        "apply_workflow_patch", "preview_workflow_patch", "undo_workflow_patch",
   573→        "get_workflow_diff", "save_workflow", "reset_workflow",
   574→        "add_node", "connect_nodes", "set_input",
   575→        "save_session", "load_session", "list_sessions", "add_note",
   576→    }
   577→    verify = {
   578→        "validate_before_execute", "execute_workflow",
   579→        "get_execution_status", "execute_with_progress",
   580→        "get_output_path", "verify_execution",
   581→    }
   582→
   583→    if tool_name in understand:
   584→        return "UNDERSTAND"
   585→    elif tool_name in discover:
   586→        return "DISCOVER"
   587→    elif tool_name in pilot:
   588→        return "PILOT"
   589→    elif tool_name in verify:
   590→        return "VERIFY"
   591→    else:
   592→        return "BRAIN"
   593→
   594→
   595→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   596→# WebSocket handler
   597→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   598→
   599→async def websocket_handler(request):
   600→    """Bidirectional WebSocket for real-time sidebar <-> agent communication."""
   601→    ws = web.WebSocketResponse()
   602→    await ws.prepare(request)
   603→
   604→    if not _ensure_brain():
   605→        await ws.send_json({
   606→            "type": "error",
   607→            "message": "Agent brain failed to load. Check logs.",
   608→        })
   609→        await ws.close()
   610→        return ws
   611→
   612→    conv = ConversationState()
   613→    _conversations[conv.id] = conv
   614→
   615→    await ws.send_json({
   616→        "type": "connected",
   617→        "conversation_id": conv.id,
   618→    })
   619→
   620→    log.info("WebSocket connected: %s", conv.id)
   621→
   622→    try:
   623→        async for raw_msg in ws:
   624→            if raw_msg.type in (web.WSMsgType.TEXT,):
   625→                try:
   626→                    data = json.loads(raw_msg.data)
   627→                except json.JSONDecodeError:
   628→                    await ws.send_json({"type": "error", "message": "Invalid JSON"})
   629→                    continue
   630→
   631→                msg_type = data.get("type", "")
   632→
   633→                if msg_type == "chat":
   634→                    content = data.get("content", "").strip()
   635→                    if not content:
   636→                        continue
   637→
   638→                    if conv.busy:
   639→                        await ws.send_json({
   640→                            "type": "error",
   641→                            "message": "Agent is still processing. Please wait.",
   642→                        })
   643→                        continue
   644→
   645→                    # Inject workflow if provided by frontend
   646→                    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
   647→                    workflow_data = data.get("workflow")
   648→                    if workflow_data and isinstance(workflow_data, dict):
   649→                        try:
   650→                            await loop.run_in_executor(
   651→                                None, _inject_workflow, conv, workflow_data
   652→                            )
   653→                        except Exception as e:
   654→                            log.warning("Workflow injection error: %s", e)
   655→
   656→                    conv.busy = True
   657→                    await ws.send_json({"type": "stage", "stage": "THINKING", "detail": ""})
   658→
   659→                    # Run agent in background thread, stream results back
   660→                    msg_queue = queue.Queue()
   661→
   662→                    thread = threading.Thread(
   663→                        target=_run_agent_sync,
   664→                        args=(conv, content, msg_queue),
   665→                        daemon=True,
   666→                    )
   667→                    thread.start()
   668→
   669→                    # Drain the queue and forward events to WebSocket
   670→                    accumulated_text = []
   671→                    while True:
   672→                        try:
   673→                            event = await loop.run_in_executor(
   674→                                None, lambda: msg_queue.get(timeout=0.1)
   675→                            )
   676→                        except queue.Empty:
   677→                            if not thread.is_alive():
   678→                                # Thread finished — drain remaining
   679→                                while not msg_queue.empty():
   680→                                    event = msg_queue.get_nowait()
   681→                                    await _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text)
   682→                                break
   683→                            continue
   684→
   685→                        await _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text)
   686→
   687→                        if event["type"] in ("done", "error"):
   688→                            break
   689→
   690→                    # Send final assembled message
   691→                    if accumulated_text:
   692→                        full_text = "".join(accumulated_text)
   693→                        await ws.send_json({
   694→                            "type": "message",
   695→                            "role": "agent",
   696→                            "content": full_text,
   697→                        })
   698→
   699→                    conv.busy = False
   700→
   701→                elif msg_type == "approve":
   702→                    # Phase 4: patch approval
   703→                    pass
   704→
   705→                elif msg_type == "reject":
   706→                    # Phase 4: patch rejection
   707→                    pass
   708→
   709→            elif raw_msg.type == web.WSMsgType.ERROR:
   710→                log.error("WebSocket error: %s", ws.exception())
   711→
   712→    finally:
   713→        _conversations.pop(conv.id, None)
   714→        log.info("WebSocket disconnected: %s", conv.id)
   715→
   716→    return ws
   717→
   718→
   719→async def _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text):
   720→    """Forward an agent event to the WebSocket client."""
   721→    etype = event["type"]
   722→
   723→    if etype == "text_delta":
   724→        # Accumulate text (we send the full message at the end)
   725→        accumulated_text.append(event["text"])
   726→        # Also send delta for live streaming
   727→        await ws.send_json({
   728→            "type": "text_delta",
   729→            "text": event["text"],
   730→        })
   731→
   732→    elif etype == "tool_call":
   733→        await ws.send_json({
   734→            "type": "stage",
   735→            "stage": event.get("stage", "THINKING"),
   736→            "detail": f"Using {event['tool']}...",
   737→        })
   738→
   739→    elif etype == "panel":
   740→        await ws.send_json({
   741→            "type": "panel",
   742→            "panel": event["panel"],
   743→        })
   744→
   745→    elif etype == "error":
   746→        await ws.send_json({
   747→            "type": "error",
   748→            "message": event.get("message", "Unknown error"),
   749→            "recoverable": True,
   750→        })
   751→
   752→    elif etype == "done":
   753→        await ws.send_json({"type": "stage", "stage": "DONE", "detail": ""})
   754→
   755→
   756→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   757→# REST endpoints
   758→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   759→
   760→async def handle_chat(request):
   761→    """POST /superduper/chat -- simple request/response chat."""
   762→    if not _ensure_brain():
   763→        return web.json_response(
   764→            {"error": "Agent brain not available"}, status=503
   765→        )
   766→
   767→    data = await request.json()
   768→    content = data.get("content", "").strip()
   769→    if not content:
   770→        return web.json_response({"error": "Empty message"}, status=400)
   771→
   772→    # Use a temporary conversation for REST endpoint
   773→    conv = ConversationState()
   774→    msg_queue = queue.Queue()
   775→
   776→    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
   777→    await loop.run_in_executor(
   778→        None, _run_agent_sync, conv, content, msg_queue
   779→    )
   780→
   781→    # Collect all text
   782→    text_parts = []
   783→    stage = "DONE"
   784→    while not msg_queue.empty():
   785→        event = msg_queue.get_nowait()
   786→        if event["type"] == "text_delta":
   787→            text_parts.append(event["text"])
   788→        elif event["type"] == "tool_call":
   789→            stage = event.get("stage", stage)
   790→
   791→    return web.json_response({
   792→        "role": "agent",
   793→        "content": "".join(text_parts),
   794→        "stage": stage,
   795→    })
   796→
   797→
   798→async def handle_status(request):
   799→    """GET /superduper/status -- agent and connection state."""
   800→    brain_ok = _ensure_brain()
   801→    return web.json_response({
   802→        "brain": "ready" if brain_ok else "unavailable",
   803→        "active_conversations": len(_conversations),
   804→        "conversations": [
   805→            {"id": c.id, "busy": c.busy, "messages": len(c.messages)}
   806→            for c in _conversations.values()
   807→        ],
   808→    })
   809→
   810→
   811→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   812→# Route setup (called from ui/__init__.py at import time)
   813→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   814→
   815→def setup_routes():
   816→    """Mount all SUPER DUPER routes on ComfyUI's PromptServer."""
   817→    try:
   818→        from server import PromptServer
   819→        routes = PromptServer.instance.routes
   820→        routes.post("/superduper/chat")(handle_chat)
   821→        routes.get("/superduper/status")(handle_status)
   822→        routes.get("/superduper/ws")(websocket_handler)
   823→        log.info("SUPER DUPER routes mounted: /superduper/chat, /superduper/status, /superduper/ws")
   824→    except Exception as e:

"""SUPER DUPER UI -- aiohttp routes mounted on ComfyUI's PromptServer.

Provides:
  POST /superduper/chat   -- synchronous chat (request/response)
  GET  /superduper/status  -- agent and connection state
  GET  /superduper/ws      -- WebSocket for real-time streaming
"""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import queue
import sys
import threading
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from aiohttp import web

log = logging.getLogger("superduper.routes")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Agent brain import (lazy — ComfyUI loads us before agent is on sys.path)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_brain_lock = threading.Lock()
_brain_ready = False
_client = None


def _ensure_brain():
    """Lazily import the agent brain and create the Anthropic client."""
    global _brain_ready, _client
    if _brain_ready:
        return True

    with _brain_lock:
        if _brain_ready:
            return True

        try:
            # Add project root to path so `agent` package is importable
            project_root = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent)
            if project_root not in sys.path:
                sys.path.insert(0, project_root)

            from agent.main import create_client
            _client = create_client()
            _brain_ready = True
            log.info("Agent brain loaded, Anthropic client ready")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Failed to load agent brain: %s", e)
            return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-connection conversation state
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ConversationState:
    """Tracks one sidebar conversation."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
        self.messages: list[dict] = []
        self.system_prompt: str | None = None
        self.busy = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.workflow_summary: dict | None = None
        self.missing_nodes: list[str] | None = None
        self._workflow_hash: int | None = None  # skip reload if unchanged
        self._first_workflow = True  # run missing-nodes check on first inject

    def _build_system(self):
        from agent.system_prompt import build_system_prompt
        base = build_system_prompt()

        # Append workflow context if available
        extras = []
        if self.workflow_summary:
            s = self.workflow_summary
            extras.append(
                "\n\n## Current Workflow (auto-injected from ComfyUI canvas)\n\n"
                f"Format: {s['format']} | Nodes: {s['node_count']} | "
                f"Connections: {s['connection_count']}\n\n"
                f"{s['summary']}\n\n"
                "The workflow is already loaded in the PILOT engine. "
                "Use PILOT tools (add_node, set_input, connect_nodes, "
                "apply_workflow_patch) directly — do NOT ask for a file path."
            )
        if self.missing_nodes:
            extras.append(
                "\n\n**Missing nodes detected:** "
                + ", ".join(self.missing_nodes)
                + "\nWarn the artist if they ask about issues or try to execute."
            )

        self.system_prompt = base + "".join(extras)


# Active conversations keyed by connection ID
_conversations: dict[str, ConversationState] = {}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workflow injection (sidebar -> agent state)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _inject_workflow(conv: ConversationState, workflow_data: dict) -> None:
    """Inject live workflow data into agent state and conversation context.

    Skips reload if the workflow hasn't changed (preserves undo history).
    Runs find_missing_nodes on first injection (best-effort).
    """
    # Quick change detection via hash of sorted JSON
    import hashlib
    from agent.tools._util import to_json as _to_json
    wf_hash = hash(_to_json(workflow_data))

    if wf_hash == conv._workflow_hash:
        # Workflow unchanged — rebuild system prompt (keeps context fresh)
        # but don't reload (preserves undo history)
        conv._build_system()
        return

    conv._workflow_hash = wf_hash

    # Load into PILOT engine
    from agent.tools.workflow_patch import load_workflow_from_data
    err = load_workflow_from_data(workflow_data, source="<sidebar>")
    if err:
        log.warning("Workflow injection failed: %s", err)
        return

    # Summarize for system prompt
    from agent.tools.workflow_parse import summarize_workflow_data
    conv.workflow_summary = summarize_workflow_data(workflow_data)

    # On first workflow injection, check for missing nodes (best-effort)
    if conv._first_workflow:
        conv._first_workflow = False
        try:
            from agent.tools.comfy_discover import handle as discover_handle
            result_json = discover_handle("find_missing_nodes", {})
            import json as _json
            result = _json.loads(result_json)
            missing = result.get("missing", [])
            if missing:
                conv.missing_nodes = [m.get("class_type", "?") for m in missing]
            else:
                conv.missing_nodes = None
        except Exception as e:
            log.debug("Missing nodes check skipped: %s", e)

    # Force system prompt rebuild with new workflow context
    conv._build_system()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Panel builders (tool result -> structured panel data for frontend)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Ordered slot classification rules (checked first to last; first match wins).
# More specific patterns before generic ones to avoid false matches.
_SLOT_RULES = [
    ("controlnet", ["controlnet", "control_net", "preprocessor", "canny", "openpose"]),
    ("vae",        ["vae"]),
    ("clip",       ["clip", "textencode", "t5"]),
    ("latent",     ["latent", "emptylatent"]),
    ("sampler",    ["sampler", "ksampler"]),
    ("conditioning", ["conditioning", "prompt"]),
    ("sigmas",     ["sigmas", "scheduler"]),
    ("guider",     ["guider"]),
    ("noise",      ["randomnoise"]),
    ("mask",       ["mask"]),
    ("image",      ["image", "preview", "save", "video", "combine"]),
    ("model",      ["checkpoint", "model", "unet", "lora", "loader"]),
]


def _classify_slot(class_type: str) -> str:
    """Keyword-based class_type -> slot type string."""
    ct_lower = class_type.lower()
    for slot_type, keywords in _SLOT_RULES:
        for kw in keywords:
            if kw in ct_lower:
                return slot_type
    return "model"  # fallback


def _extract_flow_chain(nodes: dict, max_nodes: int = 8) -> list[dict]:
    """BFS from root nodes to build a signal flow chain.

    Args:
        nodes: API format {node_id: {class_type, inputs}}
        max_nodes: Maximum nodes in chain

    Returns:
        List of {label, slotType} dicts
    """
    if not nodes:
        return []

    # Find nodes that receive input from other nodes (have upstream connections)
    has_upstream = set()
    for nid, ndata in nodes.items():
        for val in (ndata.get("inputs") or {}).values():
            if isinstance(val, list) and len(val) == 2:
                # This node (nid) receives input from val[0]
                has_upstream.add(nid)

    # Roots: nodes with no upstream connections (source nodes)
    all_ids = set(nodes.keys())
    roots = all_ids - has_upstream
    if not roots:
        roots = {sorted(all_ids)[0]} if all_ids else set()

    # BFS from roots
    visited = []
    queue_bfs = list(sorted(roots))
    seen = set()

    while queue_bfs and len(visited) < max_nodes:
        nid = queue_bfs.pop(0)
        if nid in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(nid)

        ndata = nodes.get(nid)
        if not ndata:
            continue

        ct = ndata.get("class_type", "?")
        visited.append({"label": ct, "slotType": _classify_slot(ct)})

        # Find downstream nodes (nodes that reference this nid)
        for other_id, other_data in nodes.items():
            if other_id in seen:
                continue
            for val in (other_data.get("inputs") or {}).values():
                if isinstance(val, list) and len(val) == 2 and str(val[0]) == nid:
                    queue_bfs.append(other_id)
                    break

    return visited


# Slot type -> hex color for panel dot colors
_SLOT_HEX = {
    "clip": "#FFD500", "clip_vision": "#A8DADC", "conditioning": "#FFA931",
    "controlnet": "#6EE7B7", "image": "#64B5F6", "latent": "#FF9CF9",
    "mask": "#81C784", "model": "#B39DDB", "style_model": "#C2FFAE",
    "vae": "#FF6E6E", "noise": "#B0B0B0", "guider": "#66FFFF",

}


def _panel_workflow_analysis(result: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Build panel data from load_workflow / validate_workflow result."""
    # Extract nodes from result
    nodes = result.get("nodes") or result.get("workflow") or {}
    if isinstance(nodes, str):
        return None

    # If result has API-format workflow data embedded
    if not nodes and "node_count" in result:
        # Minimal header-only panel
        return {
            "type": "workflow_analysis",
            "header": {
                "label": "workflow \u00b7 analysis",
                "badge": result.get("format", "workflow"),
                "title": result.get("loaded_path", "Workflow loaded").split("/")[-1].split("\\")[-1],
                "summary": f"{result.get('node_count', '?')} nodes, "
                           f"{result.get('connection_count', '?')} connections. "
                           f"Format: {result.get('format', 'unknown')}.",
                "stats": [
                    {"value": str(result.get("node_count", "?")), "label": "nodes"},
                    {"value": str(result.get("connection_count", "?")), "label": "connections"},
                ],
            },
            "sections": [],
            "footer": {"status": "loaded", "actions": [
                {"label": "Modify", "variant": "secondary"},
                {"label": "Run", "variant": "primary"},
            ]},
        }

    # Full analysis with node classification
    # Group nodes by slot type
    groups = {}
    for nid, ndata in nodes.items():
        ct = ndata.get("class_type", "?")
        slot = _classify_slot(ct)
        groups.setdefault(slot, []).append({"label": ct, "slotType": slot})

    # Count connections
    conn_count = 0
    for ndata in nodes.values():
        for val in (ndata.get("inputs") or {}).values():
            if isinstance(val, list) and len(val) == 2:
                conn_count += 1

    # Build flow chain
    flow = _extract_flow_chain(nodes)

    # Determine workflow type from nodes
    class_types = {n.get("class_type", "").lower() for n in nodes.values()}
    wf_type = "workflow"
    if any("video" in c or "animatediff" in c or "svd" in c for c in class_types):
        wf_type = "video gen"
    elif any("controlnet" in c for c in class_types):
        wf_type = "controlnet"
    elif any("img2img" in c or "inpaint" in c for c in class_types):
        wf_type = "img2img"
    else:
        wf_type = "txt2img"

    sections = []

    # Signal Flow section (open by default)
    if flow:
        sections.append({
            "title": "Signal Flow",
            "dotColor": "#00BB81",
            "count": len(flow),
            "defaultOpen": True,
            "type": "flow_chain",
            "data": {"chains": [{"nodes": flow}]},
        })

    # Node group sections (collapsed)
    # Priority order for display
    group_order = ["model", "clip", "conditioning", "sampler", "vae",
                   "controlnet", "image", "latent", "mask", "noise",
                   "guider", "sigmas"]
    group_labels = {
        "model": "Models & Loaders", "clip": "Text Encoding",
        "conditioning": "Conditioning", "sampler": "Sampling",
        "vae": "VAE", "controlnet": "ControlNet", "image": "Image I/O",
        "latent": "Latent Space", "mask": "Masks", "noise": "Noise",
        "guider": "Guidance", "sigmas": "Noise Schedule",
    }

    for slot in group_order:
        if slot not in groups:
            continue
        tags = groups[slot]
        # Deduplicate tags
        seen = {}
        deduped = []
        for t in tags:
            key = t["label"]
            if key in seen:
                seen[key] += 1
            else:
                seen[key] = 1
                deduped.append(t)
        # Add counts to labels
        final_tags = []
        for t in deduped:
            label = t["label"]
            count = seen[label]
            if count > 1:
                label = f"{label} \u00d7{count}"
            final_tags.append({"label": label, "slotType": t["slotType"]})

        sections.append({
            "title": group_labels.get(slot, slot.title()),
            "dotColor": _SLOT_HEX.get(slot, "#9a9caa"),
            "count": len(tags),
            "defaultOpen": False,
            "type": "slot_tags",
            "data": {"tags": final_tags},
        })

    return {
        "type": "workflow_analysis",
        "header": {
            "label": "workflow \u00b7 analysis",
            "badge": wf_type,
            "title": "Workflow Analysis",
            "summary": f"{len(nodes)} nodes, {conn_count} connections.",
            "stats": [
                {"value": str(len(nodes)), "label": "nodes"},
                {"value": str(conn_count), "label": "connections"},
                {"value": wf_type, "label": "type"},
            ],
        },
        "sections": sections,
        "footer": {"status": "loaded", "actions": [
            {"label": "Modify", "variant": "secondary"},
            {"label": "Run", "variant": "primary"},
        ]},
    }


def _panel_discovery(result: dict, tool_input: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Build panel data from discover tool results."""
    results_list = result.get("results", [])
    if not results_list:
        return None

    query = tool_input.get("query", "search")
    category = tool_input.get("category", "all")

    sections = []
    max_results = 5
    for item in results_list[:max_results]:
        name = item.get("name", item.get("title", "Unknown"))
        desc = item.get("description", "")[:120]
        source = item.get("source", "")
        installed = item.get("installed", False)

        tags = []
        if item.get("model_type") or item.get("type"):
            t = item.get("model_type") or item.get("type")
            slot = _classify_slot(str(t))
            tags.append({"label": str(t), "slotType": slot})
        if installed:
            tags.append({"label": "installed", "slotType": "controlnet"})

        rows = []
        if source:
            rows.append({"label": "Source", "value": source})
        if item.get("downloads"):
            rows.append({"label": "Downloads", "value": str(item["downloads"])})
        if item.get("rating"):
            rows.append({"label": "Rating", "value": str(item["rating"])})

        section_data = {}
        section_type = "detail_rows"
        if tags:
            section_type = "slot_tags"
            section_data["tags"] = tags
        if rows:
            section_type = "detail_rows"
            section_data["rows"] = rows

        sections.append({
            "title": name,
            "dotColor": "#00BB81",
            "count": None,
            "defaultOpen": len(sections) == 0,  # first result open
            "type": section_type,
            "data": section_data,
        })

    return {

                       f"Top result: {results_list[0].get('name', '?')}.",
            "stats": [
                {"value": str(len(results_list)), "label": "found"},
            ],
        },
        "sections": sections,
        "footer": {
            "status": "ready",
            "actions": [{"label": "Details", "variant": "secondary"}],
        },
    }


# Tools that produce panelable results
_PANEL_TOOLS = {
    "load_workflow", "validate_workflow",
    "discover",
}


def _build_panel_for_tool(name: str, tool_input: dict, result_json: str) -> dict | None:
    """Dispatch tool result to appropriate panel builder. Returns panel dict or None."""
    if name not in _PANEL_TOOLS:
        return None

    try:
        result = json.loads(result_json) if isinstance(result_json, str) else result_json
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
        return None

    if isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("error"):
        return None

    if name in ("load_workflow", "validate_workflow"):
        return _panel_workflow_analysis(result)
    elif name == "discover":
        return _panel_discovery(result, tool_input)

    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Synchronous agent runner (called from thread)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _run_agent_sync(conv: ConversationState, user_text: str, msg_queue: queue.Queue):
    """Run the agent loop synchronously, pushing events to msg_queue.

    Events are dicts: {"type": "text_delta"|"tool_call"|"stage"|"done"|"error", ...}
    """
    from agent.main import run_agent_turn
    from agent.tools import ALL_TOOLS

    conv._build_system()
    conv.messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user_text})

    max_turns = 15  # safety limit per user message

    for turn in range(max_turns):
        try:
            def on_text(text):
                msg_queue.put({"type": "text_delta", "text": text})

            def on_tool(name, inp):
                # Infer stage from tool name
                stage = _infer_stage(name)
                msg_queue.put({
                    "type": "tool_call",
                    "tool": name,
                    "stage": stage,
                })

            def on_result(name, inp, result_json):
                panel = _build_panel_for_tool(name, inp, result_json)
                if panel:
                    msg_queue.put({"type": "panel", "panel": panel})

            conv.messages, done = run_agent_turn(
                _client,
                conv.messages,
                conv.system_prompt,
                on_text_delta=on_text,
                on_tool_call=on_tool,
                on_tool_result=on_result,
            )

            if done:
                msg_queue.put({"type": "done"})
                return

        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Agent turn error: %s", e, exc_info=True)
            msg_queue.put({"type": "error", "message": str(e)})
            return

    msg_queue.put({"type": "done"})


def _infer_stage(tool_name: str) -> str:
    """Map tool name to intelligence layer stage."""
    understand = {
        "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
        "is_comfyui_running", "get_all_nodes", "get_node_info",
        "get_system_stats", "get_queue_status", "get_history",
        "list_custom_nodes", "list_models", "get_models_summary",
        "read_node_source",
    }
    discover = {
        "discover", "find_missing_nodes", "check_registry_freshness",
        "get_install_instructions", "get_civitai_model", "get_trending_models",
        "list_workflow_templates", "get_workflow_template",
        "check_node_updates", "get_repo_releases",
        "identify_model_family", "check_model_compatibility",
    }
    pilot = {
        "apply_workflow_patch", "preview_workflow_patch", "undo_workflow_patch",
        "get_workflow_diff", "save_workflow", "reset_workflow",
        "add_node", "connect_nodes", "set_input",
        "save_session", "load_session", "list_sessions", "add_note",
    }
    verify = {
        "validate_before_execute", "execute_workflow",
        "get_execution_status", "execute_with_progress",
        "get_output_path", "verify_execution",
    }

    if tool_name in understand:
        return "UNDERSTAND"
    elif tool_name in discover:
        return "DISCOVER"
    elif tool_name in pilot:
        return "PILOT"
    elif tool_name in verify:
        return "VERIFY"
    else:
        return "BRAIN"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WebSocket handler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async def websocket_handler(request):
    """Bidirectional WebSocket for real-time sidebar <-> agent communication."""
    ws = web.WebSocketResponse()
    await ws.prepare(request)

    if not _ensure_brain():
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "error",
            "message": "Agent brain failed to load. Check logs.",
        })
        await ws.close()
        return ws

    conv = ConversationState()
    _conversations[conv.id] = conv

    await ws.send_json({
        "type": "connected",
        "conversation_id": conv.id,
    })

    log.info("WebSocket connected: %s", conv.id)

    try:
        async for raw_msg in ws:
            if raw_msg.type in (web.WSMsgType.TEXT,):
                try:
                    data = json.loads(raw_msg.data)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    await ws.send_json({"type": "error", "message": "Invalid JSON"})
                    continue

                msg_type = data.get("type", "")

                if msg_type == "chat":
                    content = data.get("content", "").strip()
                    if not content:
                        continue

                    if conv.busy:
                        await ws.send_json({
                            "type": "error",
                            "message": "Agent is still processing. Please wait.",
                        })
                        continue

                    # Inject workflow if provided by frontend
                    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
                    workflow_data = data.get("workflow")
                    if workflow_data and isinstance(workflow_data, dict):
                        try:
                            await loop.run_in_executor(
                                None, _inject_workflow, conv, workflow_data
                            )
                        except Exception as e:
                            log.warning("Workflow injection error: %s", e)

                    conv.busy = True
                    await ws.send_json({"type": "stage", "stage": "THINKING", "detail": ""})

                    # Run agent in background thread, stream results back
                    msg_queue = queue.Queue()

                    thread = threading.Thread(
                        target=_run_agent_sync,
                        args=(conv, content, msg_queue),
                        daemon=True,
                    )
                    thread.start()

                    # Drain the queue and forward events to WebSocket
                    accumulated_text = []
                    while True:
                        try:
                            event = await loop.run_in_executor(
                                None, lambda: msg_queue.get(timeout=0.1)
                            )
                        except queue.Empty:
                            if not thread.is_alive():
                                # Thread finished — drain remaining
                                while not msg_queue.empty():
                                    event = msg_queue.get_nowait()
                                    await _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text)
                                break
                            continue

                        await _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text)

                        if event["type"] in ("done", "error"):
                            break

                    # Send final assembled message
                    if accumulated_text:
                        full_text = "".join(accumulated_text)
                        await ws.send_json({
                            "type": "message",
                            "role": "agent",
                            "content": full_text,
                        })

                    conv.busy = False

                elif msg_type == "approve":
                    # Phase 4: patch approval
                    pass

                elif msg_type == "reject":
                    # Phase 4: patch rejection
                    pass

            elif raw_msg.type == web.WSMsgType.ERROR:
                log.error("WebSocket error: %s", ws.exception())

    finally:
        _conversations.pop(conv.id, None)
        log.info("WebSocket disconnected: %s", conv.id)

    return ws


async def _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text):
    """Forward an agent event to the WebSocket client."""
    etype = event["type"]

    if etype == "text_delta":
        # Accumulate text (we send the full message at the end)
        accumulated_text.append(event["text"])
        # Also send delta for live streaming
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "text_delta",
            "text": event["text"],
        })

    elif etype == "tool_call":
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "stage",
            "stage": event.get("stage", "THINKING"),
            "detail": f"Using {event['tool']}...",
        })

    elif etype == "panel":
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "panel",
            "panel": event["panel"],
        })

    elif etype == "error":
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "error",
            "message": event.get("message", "Unknown error"),
            "recoverable": True,
        })

    elif etype == "done":
        await ws.send_json({"type": "stage", "stage": "DONE", "detail": ""})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REST endpoints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async def handle_chat(request):
    """POST /superduper/chat -- simple request/response chat."""
    if not _ensure_brain():
        return web.json_response(
            {"error": "Agent brain not available"}, status=503
        )

    data = await request.json()
    content = data.get("content", "").strip()
    if not content:
        return web.json_response({"error": "Empty message"}, status=400)

    # Use a temporary conversation for REST endpoint
    conv = ConversationState()
    msg_queue = queue.Queue()

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    await loop.run_in_executor(
        None, _run_agent_sync, conv, content, msg_queue
    )

    # Collect all text
    text_parts = []
    stage = "DONE"
    while not msg_queue.empty():
        event = msg_queue.get_nowait()
        if event["type"] == "text_delta":
            text_parts.append(event["text"])
        elif event["type"] == "tool_call":
            stage = event.get("stage", stage)

    return web.json_response({
        "role": "agent",
        "content": "".join(text_parts),
        "stage": stage,
    })


async def handle_status(request):
    """GET /superduper/status -- agent and connection state."""
    brain_ok = _ensure_brain()
    return web.json_response({
        "brain": "ready" if brain_ok else "unavailable",
        "active_conversations": len(_conversations),
        "conversations": [
            {"id": c.id, "busy": c.busy, "messages": len(c.messages)}
            for c in _conversations.values()
        ],
    })


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Route setup (called from ui/__init__.py at import time)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def setup_routes():
    """Mount all SUPER DUPER routes on ComfyUI's PromptServer."""
    try:
        from server import PromptServer
        routes = PromptServer.instance.routes
        routes.post("/superduper/chat")(handle_chat)
        routes.get("/superduper/status")(handle_status)
        routes.get("/superduper/ws")(websocket_handler)
        log.info("SUPER DUPER routes mounted: /superduper/chat, /superduper/status, /superduper/ws")
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Failed to mount SUPER DUPER routes: %s", e)

### 1. ComfyUI Native Color Inheritance
ComfyUI's LiteGraph dark theme uses specific CSS variables and raw hex values. Our panel must inherit from these rather than defining a parallel brand system. ```python
def _extract_nodes_touched(tool_name: str, tool_input: dict, conv: ConversationState) -> list[dict]:
    """Extract which nodes a tool call is interacting with.

    Returns list of {"node_id": str, "class_type": str, "slot_type": str}
    """
    nodes_touched = []

    # Tools that directly reference nodes
    node_tools = {
        "set_input": ["node_id"],
        "connect_nodes": ["source_node_id", "target_node_id", "from_node", "to_node"],
        "add_node": ["class_type"],
        "get_node_info": ["class_type", "node_type"],
        "apply_workflow_patch": [],  # parse from patch ops
    }

    if tool_name not in node_tools and tool_name not in (
        "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
        "preview_workflow_patch", "validate_before_execute",
    ):
        return nodes_touched

    # Get current workflow from PILOT state (if available)
    wf_nodes = {}
    if conv.workflow_summary:
        try:
            from agent.tools.workflow_patch import _state
            wf = _state.get("working")
            if isinstance(wf, dict):
                wf_nodes = wf
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Extract node_id references from tool input
    node_id_keys = node_tools.get(tool_name, [])
    for key in node_id_keys:
        val = tool_input.get(key)
        if val is None:
            continue

        if key == "class_type":
            # add_node: we know class_type but not node_id yet
            nodes_touched.append({
                "node_id": None,
                "class_type": str(val),
                "slot_type": _classify_slot(str(val)),
            })
        else:
            # node_id reference — look up class_type from workflow
            nid = str(val)
            ndata = wf_nodes.get(nid, {})
            ct = ndata.get("class_type", f"Node {nid}")
            nodes_touched.append({
                "node_id": nid,
                "class_type": ct,
                "slot_type": _classify_slot(ct),
            })

    # For patch tools, extract node_ids from RFC6902 paths
    if tool_name == "apply_workflow_patch":
        patches = tool_input.get("patches") or tool_input.get("patch") or []
        if isinstance(patches, list):
            seen_ids = set()
            for op in patches:
                path = op.get("path", "")
                # Path format: /node_id/inputs/field_name
                parts = path.strip("/").split("/")
                if parts and parts[0] not in seen_ids:
                    nid = parts[0]
                    seen_ids.add(nid)
                    ndata = wf_nodes.get(nid, {})
                    ct = ndata.get("class_type", f"Node {nid}")
                    nodes_touched.append({
                        "node_id": nid,
                        "class_type": ct,
                        "slot_type": _classify_slot(ct),
                    })

    return nodes_touched
```

```javascript
/**
 * Create an interactive node pill for inline display in messages/stage bar.
 * Shows node class_type with slot-appropriate color.
 * Hover/click highlights the node on ComfyUI canvas.
 *
 * @param {string} classType - Node class_type (e.g., "KSampler")
 * @param {string} slotType - Slot type key (e.g., "sampler")
 * @param {string|null} nodeId - Node ID for canvas highlighting (null if unknown)
 */
export function createNodePill(classType, slotType, nodeId) {
  const color = _slotColor(slotType);
  const pill = document.createElement("span");
  pill.className = "sd-node-pill";
  pill.style.setProperty("--pill-color", color);

  // Colored dot
  const dot = document.createElement("span");
  dot.className = "sd-node-pill__dot";
  pill.appendChild(dot);

  // Label — use short display name (strip common suffixes)
  const shortName = classType
    .replace(/Simple$/, "")
    .replace(/Advanced$/, "")
    .replace(/Loader$/, "")
    .replace(/^ComfyUI_/, "");
  const label = document.createTextNode(shortName);
  pill.appendChild(label);

  // Interactive: highlight node on canvas
  if (nodeId) {
    pill.style.cursor = "pointer";
    pill.title = `${classType} (node #${nodeId}) — click to select on canvas`;

    pill.addEventListener("click", () => {
      try {
        // ComfyUI app API: select node on canvas
        const graph = app.graph;
        if (graph) {
          const node = graph.getNodeById(parseInt(nodeId, 10));
          if (node) {
            app.canvas.deselectAllNodes();
            app.canvas.selectNode(node);
            app.canvas.centerOnNode(node);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("[Super Duper] Could not highlight node:", e);
      }
    });

    pill.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      try {
        const graph = app.graph;
        if (graph) {
          const node = graph.getNodeById(parseInt(nodeId, 10));
          if (node) {
            // Temporarily highlight with a colored border
            node._sd_orig_color = node.color;
            node.color = color;
            app.canvas.setDirty(true, true);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
    });

    pill.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      try {
        const graph = app.graph;
        if (graph) {
          const node = graph.getNodeById(parseInt(nodeId, 10));
          if (node && node._sd_orig_color !== undefined) {
            node.color = node._sd_orig_color;
            delete node._sd_orig_color;
            app.canvas.setDirty(true, true);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
    });
  } else {
    pill.title = classType;
  }

  return pill;
}
```

**Task B1: Add node extraction from tool inputs**

Add a new function `_extract_nodes_touched()` that inspects tool_name and tool_input to determine which nodes the tool is interacting with. Add it after the `_infer_stage()` function:

```python
def _extract_nodes_touched(tool_name: str, tool_input: dict, conv: ConversationState) -> list[dict]:
    """Extract which nodes a tool call is interacting with.

    Returns list of {"node_id": str, "class_type": str, "slot_type": str}
    """
    nodes_touched = []

    # Tools that directly reference nodes
    node_tools = {
        "set_input": ["node_id"],
        "connect_nodes": ["source_node_id", "target_node_id", "from_node", "to_node"],
        "add_node": ["class_type"],
        "get_node_info": ["class_type", "node_type"],
        "apply_workflow_patch": [],  # parse from patch ops
    }

    if tool_name not in node_tools and tool_name not in (
        "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
        "preview_workflow_patch", "validate_before_execute",
    ):
        return nodes_touched

    # Get current workflow from PILOT state (if available)
    wf_nodes = {}
    if conv.workflow_summary:
        try:
            from agent.tools.workflow_patch import _state
            wf = _state.get("working")
            if isinstance(wf, dict):
                wf_nodes = wf
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Extract node_id references from tool input
    node_id_keys = node_tools.get(tool_name, [])
    for key in node_id_keys:
        val = tool_input.get(key)
        if val is None:
            continue

        if key == "class_type":
            # add_node: we know class_type but not node_id yet
            nodes_touched.append({
                "node_id": None,
                "class_type": str(val),
                "slot_type": _classify_slot(str(val)),
            })
        else:
            # node_id reference — look up class_type from workflow
            nid = str(val)
            ndata = wf_nodes.get(nid, {})
            ct = ndata.get("class_type", f"Node {nid}")
            nodes_touched.append({
                "node_id": nid,
                "class_type": ct,
                "slot_type": _classify_slot(ct),
            })

    # For patch tools, extract node_ids from RFC6902 paths
    if tool_name == "apply_workflow_patch":
        patches = tool_input.get("patches") or tool_input.get("patch") or []
        if isinstance(patches, list):
            seen_ids = set()
            for op in patches:
                path = op.get("path", "")
                # Path format: /node_id/inputs/field_name
                parts = path.strip("/").split("/")
                if parts and parts[0] not in seen_ids:
                    nid = parts[0]
                    seen_ids.add(nid)
                    ndata = wf_nodes.get(nid, {})
                    ct = ndata.get("class_type", f"Node {nid}")
                    nodes_touched.append({
                        "node_id": nid,
                        "class_type": ct,
                        "slot_type": _classify_slot(ct),
                    })

    return nodes_touched
```

```javascript
/**
 * Create an interactive node pill for inline display in messages/stage bar.
 * Shows node class_type with slot-appropriate color.
 * Hover/click highlights the node on ComfyUI canvas.
 *
 * @param {string} classType - Node class_type (e.g., "KSampler")
 * @param {string} slotType - Slot type key (e.g., "sampler")
 * @param {string|null} nodeId - Node ID for canvas highlighting (null if unknown)
 */
export function createNodePill(classType, slotType, nodeId) {
  const color = _slotColor(slotType);
  const pill = document.createElement("span");
  pill.className = "sd-node-pill";
  pill.style.setProperty("--pill-color", color);

  // Colored dot
  const dot = document.createElement("span");
  dot.className = "sd-node-pill__dot";
  pill.appendChild(dot);

  // Label — use short display name (strip common suffixes)
  const shortName = classType
    .replace(/Simple$/, "")
    .replace(/Advanced$/, "")
    .replace(/Loader$/, "")
    .replace(/^ComfyUI_/, "");
  const label = document.createTextNode(shortName);
  pill.appendChild(label);

  // Interactive: highlight node on canvas
  if (nodeId) {
    pill.style.cursor = "pointer";
    pill.title = `${classType} (node #${nodeId}) — click to select on canvas`;

    pill.addEventListener("click", () => {
      try {
        // ComfyUI app API: select node on canvas
        const graph = app.graph;
        if (graph) {
          const node = graph.getNodeById(parseInt(nodeId, 10));
          if (node) {
            app.canvas.deselectAllNodes();
            app.canvas.selectNode(node);
            app.canvas.centerOnNode(node);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("[Super Duper] Could not highlight node:", e);
      }
    });

    pill.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      try {
        const graph = app.graph;
        if (graph) {
          const node = graph.getNodeById(parseInt(nodeId, 10));
          if (node) {
            // Temporarily highlight with a colored border
            node._sd_orig_color = node.color;
            node.color = color;
            app.canvas.setDirty(true, true);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
    });

    pill.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      try {
        const graph = app.graph;
        if (graph) {
          const node = graph.getNodeById(parseInt(nodeId, 10));
          if (node && node._sd_orig_color !== undefined) {
            node.color = node._sd_orig_color;
            delete node._sd_orig_color;
            app.canvas.setDirty(true, true);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
    });
  } else {
    pill.title = classType;
  }

  return pill;
}
```
